description: Replays the 'build-leaderboard' page: Redis and the dashboard agree, and the top 3 are the documented seed-42 scores.

tests.description: The leaderboard shows the documented top 3 for seed 42

runShell.command: for i in $(seq 1 30); do lag=$(docker compose exec -T rpk rpk group describe leaderboard </dev/null 2>/dev/null | awk '/^TOTAL-LAG/ {print $2}'); [ "$lag" = 0 ] && break; sleep 2; done; echo lag=$lag
docker compose exec -T redis redis-cli ZCARD leaderboard:global
